label: Queue
description: Lets waiting players queue politely for a slot and mark themselves AFK.

commands.name: afk
commands.description: Marks the calling player (or the specified player, with permission) as AFK.

commands.name: here
commands.description: Marks the calling player as available again.

commands.name: teamsize
commands.description: Internal — pushes a queued player in when a slot frees up after a teamsize change.

cvars.label: Set-Others-AFK Permission
cvars.description: Minimum permission level required to mark another player as AFK.

cvars.label: AFK Tag
cvars.description: Text appended to a player's name while marked AFK.
